title: shrI rAmachandhra - gowlam - Geetham - roopakam - Paidala Gurumurthy Sastry
name: shrI rAmachandhra

lyrics: shrI rAmachandhra sAkEthapura vAsA - muni jana mAnasa hamsa
nikhila lOka pAlana dhurINa kauslyA bhAgya roopa
pAdha kamala maNi sankRpAlo gAna phNithima kalaya mudhamathulam dhEhi mE
bhO swAmin pAlaya mAm gurumoorthi nAmakam

text: O Lord! Shree Raamachandra of Ayodhya, you are like a swan in the hearts of all devotees, and you are the ruler and bearer of all lokas. You fulfilled Dasharadh's wish, and you were good fortune to Kausalya in being her son. I, Gurumurti, bow to your feet and praise you, that you may shower your grace and give me a thought of a beautiful song, with a mixture of good idioms and incomparable phrases to praise you. Hey Lord! Protect me.

lyric: shrI rAmacandra sAkEtapuravAsA munijana mAnasa hamsa nikhila lOka pAlana
dhuriNa kausalyAbhAgya rUpa dashAradE purayamE vAncAm tava vandE
pAda kamala maNI sankrpalO gAna phaNitima kalaya mudamatulam dEhi mE
bhO svAmin pAlaya mAm gurumUrti nAmakam
text: O Lord! Shree Raamachandra of Ayodhya (sAkEtapuravAsA), you are like a swan (hamsa) in the hearts (mAnasa) of all devotees (munijana), and you are the ruler (pAlana) and bearer (dhuriNa) of all lokas (nikhila lOka). You fulfilled (pura yamE) Dasharadh's (dashAradE) wish (vAncAm), and you were good fortune (bhAgyarUpa) to Kausalya in being her son. I, Gurumurti, bow my body (manisha) to your (tava) lotus-like (kamala) feet (pAda) and praise you (vandE), that you may shower your grace and give (dEhi) me (mE) a thought of a beautiful (amudam) song (gAna), with a mixture (kalaya) of good idioms (phaNiti) and incomparable phrases (atulam) to praise you. Hey Lord! Protect me.
